players.name: C.J. Stroud
players.note: Richard's preferred QB replacement if available. Averaging 19.5 fantasy points per game; 24 points in Week 6. Week 7 NYG, Week 8 bye.

players.name: Germie Bernard

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.

players.name: Keenan Allen

players.name: DeMario Douglas

players.name: Jordan Mason

players.name: Zach Charbonnet

players.name: Woody Marks

players.name: Kendre Miller
